component.name: Text
component.description: Renders body-level text using semantic size tokens. Covers body copy, small text, metadata, and label sizes. Polymorphic via the as prop. Does not add margin.

useWhen: Rendering body copy, descriptions, or explanatory prose
Rendering UI labels that are not interactive (use Button for clickable labels)
Rendering supporting metadata such as timestamps, counts, or secondary context

notFor.case: Using Text for page headings or section titles
notFor.because: Text is sized for body content. Heading sizes start at title-small.
notFor.note: Use Heading with size title-small, subheader, headline, headline-serif, or display

patterns.name: body-section
patterns.description: A Heading followed by Text inside a Stack to form a titled content block.

useWhen.body-default: Standard body copy. 1rem, regular weight, 1.5 line-height.
useWhen.body-small: Secondary body text or sidebar content. 0.875rem, 1.4 line-height.
useWhen.metadata: Supporting details such as timestamps, counts, tags. 0.875rem.
useWhen.label: UI labels for form fields and controls. 1rem, bold weight, single line-height.
useWhen.inherit: No typography of its own — font-family/size/weight/line-height inherit from the parent. Use only when nesting Text as="span" inside a Heading (or other typographic ancestor) purely to change color.

useWhen.default: Primary reading colour on the page surface.
useWhen.subtle: De-emphasised secondary text and supporting metadata.
useWhen.brand: Brand-coloured emphasis; use sparingly for accent text.
useWhen.disabled: Text in a disabled or inactive context.
useWhen.inverted: Primary text colour on an inverted (dark) surface, e.g. a CTA banner or footer.
useWhen.inverted-subtle: De-emphasised text on an inverted (dark) surface.
useWhen.accent-inverted: Accent-coloured emphasis on an inverted (dark) surface.

rules.case: Nesting Text as="span" inside a Heading to recolor part of the heading text
rules.because: Every Text size option other than inherit sets its own font-family/font-size/font-weight/line-height, which overrides the Heading's typography instead of just changing color.
rules.do: Pass size="inherit" so the span only changes color and inherits typography from the Heading.
